description: Office of the Public Service Commission - The Medical Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Health Service.
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to the Medical Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Health Service, specifically detailing educational qualifications, service requirements, and appointment criteria for various medical administrative grades (Deputy Medical Administrative Grade, Senior Medical Administrative Grade, and Deputy Director-General Grade). The content focuses on public service recruitment criteria, qualifications, and service conditions within the health sector, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with public sector service administration and appointment regulations.
